label: AquaClean Bridge
info: Geberit AquaClean Bridge over MQTT. See the comment nodes and the README on flows.nodered.org.

name: 1. Set your broker and settings, then Deploy
info:
Double-click **MQTT broker (edit me)** (in any MQTT node) and enter your broker.

Then open **Settings** and adjust if needed:

- `topicPrefix`: the bridge's *MQTT topic prefix* (default `aquaclean`)
- `discoveryPrefix`: the discovery prefix (default `homeassistant`)
- `language`: `auto` (the bridge's language) or a code such as `en`, `nl`, `de`, `ja`, `zh-TW`, `pt-BR`
- `allowSharedWrites`: see the README (user profiles over MQTT)
- `onlyChanges`: send a state only when it changed
- `contextName`: name of the global context object with every state

info:
Wire a **link out** node to **AquaClean command** (or use a link call) from any tab.

- `msg.topic`: the entity key, e.g. `shower_toggle`, `orientation_light`, `light_color`
- `msg.payload`: buttons anything; switches and the light `true`, `false` or `"toggle"`; numbers a number; selections the option number or its text in any language; times `"HH:MM"`; texts a text

Errors are raised with `node.error`, so a **catch** node can handle them.
